command: import pya,json,collections; from pathlib import Path; d=pya.LayoutVsSchematic(); paths=list(Path("${RESULTS_ROOT}/digital-strict-lvs-20260923-r1/reports").glob("*.lvsdb")); assert len(paths)==1;d.read(str(paths[0])); r=d.reference.circuit_by_name("G1_DIGITAL"); xr=d.xref(); pair=next(p for p in xr.each_circuit_pair() if p.second() and p.second().name=="G1_DIGITAL"); paired={p.second().qname() for p in xr.each_net_pair(pair) if p.second()}; degree=collections.Counter(); [degree.update([r.net_for_pin(p.id()).qname()]) for p in r.each_pin() if r.net_for_pin(p.id())]; [degree.update([i.net_for_pin(p.id()).qname()]) for i in r.each_subcircuit() for p in i.circuit_ref().each_pin() if i.net_for_pin(p.id())]; missing=[dict(name=n.name,qname=n.qname(),degree=degree[n.qname()]) for n in r.each_net() if n.qname() not in paired];print(json.dumps(dict(missing=missing,devices=sum(1 for x in r.each_device()),paired=len(paired)),indent=2))
